verses.text: A Psalm. A Song for the Sabbath day. [It is] good to give thanks to YHWH, and to sing praise to Your name, O Most High,

segments.text: A Psalm. A Song for the Sabbath day. [It is] good to give thanks to YHWH, and to sing praise to Your name, O Most High,

verses.text: to declare in the morning Your loving devotion, and Your faithfulness in the nights,

segments.text: to declare in the morning Your loving devotion, and Your faithfulness in the nights,

verses.text: on ten strings and on the harp, with a melody of the lyre.

segments.text: on ten strings and on the harp, with a melody of the lyre.

verses.text: For You have made me glad, O YHWH, by Your work; at the works of Your hands I shout [for joy].

segments.text: For You have made me glad, O YHWH, by Your work; at the works of Your hands I shout [for joy].

verses.text: How great are Your works, O YHWH, [how] very deep Your thoughts!

segments.text: How great are Your works, O YHWH, [how] very deep Your thoughts!

verses.text: A stupid man does not know, and a fool cannot understand this:

segments.text: A stupid man does not know, and a fool cannot understand this:

verses.text: The wicked sprout like grass, and all the workers of iniquity blossom, to be destroyed forever and ever!

segments.text: The wicked sprout like grass, and all the workers of iniquity blossom, to be destroyed forever and ever!

verses.text: And You [are] on high forever, O YHWH!

segments.text: And You [are] on high forever, O YHWH!

verses.text: For behold, Your enemies, O YHWH—for behold, Your enemies will perish; all the workers of iniquity will be separated!

segments.text: For behold, Your enemies, O YHWH—for behold, Your enemies will perish; all the workers of iniquity will be separated!

verses.text: But You have lifted high my horn like that of a wild ox; I have been anointed with fresh oil.

segments.text: But You have lifted high my horn like that of a wild ox; I have been anointed with fresh oil.

verses.text: And my eye has looked on my enemies; of those rising up against me, those doing evil, my ears hear.

segments.text: And my eye has looked on my enemies; of those rising up against me, those doing evil, my ears hear.

verses.text: The righteous one will sprout like a palm tree; like a cedar in Lebanon he will grow.

segments.text: The righteous one will sprout like a palm tree; like a cedar in Lebanon he will grow.

verses.text: Those planted in the house of YHWH, in the courts of our God, they will sprout.

segments.text: Those planted in the house of YHWH, in the courts of our God, they will sprout.

verses.text: Still bearing fruit in old age, they will remain fat and flourishing—

segments.text: Still bearing fruit in old age, they will remain fat and flourishing—

verses.text: to declare that YHWH my Rock [is] upright, and [there is] no injustice in Him.
